title: MILF vows to work with gov't to deliver Bangsamoro peace deal in full
summary: COTABATO CITY — The Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) has committed to work with the national government to fully deliver the promises of the Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro (CAB),…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) has committed to work with the national government to fully deliver the promises of the Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro (CAB), saying it wants more than the formal conclusion of the peace process. “For its part, the MILF does not seek merely the formal conclusion of the peace process. We seek the successful realization of the aspirations for which this peace process was undertaken,” the MILF said in a statement. “We trust that both parties will work hard, and work together, to deliver the promises of the CAB in full,” it added.
